title: Stale comment names type 'Contact' where code sends 'ChatContact'
description: Test comment at events.rs line 1382 reads 'Contact s-1, Chat s-2, Message s-42' but the code at line 1415 sends type_name: "ChatContact". The comment was not updated when type_name was renamed from 'Contact' to 'ChatContact'. Low-stakes but misleading to the next reader.
